integrity: A symbolic proof establishes infinite and finite cases; the standalone verifier exhausts finite unary term clones on sizes 2 through 17. Originality remains subject to possible equivalent older or unpublished descriptions.
scientific_limitations: Only parameter-free one-variable nonmodal term equations for {0, meet, Gödel implication, involution} on the standard [0,1] algebra and its equally spaced finite involution-closed subchains; no many-variable or modal finite-model claim.
title: Five-point unary-equation completeness for involutive Gödel logic
